observed_prior_rank_aware_design.geometry_rule: Project three class centroids into the admitted orthonormal 1D/2D basis, divide by one shared geometry scale, then restore the zero-sum simplex invariant.
observed_prior_rank_aware_design.why_it_matters: The design explicitly allows the three-state relation to be rank 2 and preserves relative class geometry instead of forcing three independently unit-normalized radial directions.

observed_queued_executor.semantic_estimator: group class means at layer-input 21 and 24, nuisance-residualize each layer, then independently convert each projected class vector to unit norm
observed_queued_executor.downstream_metric: For each holdout case, compute d = intervened_layer24 - baseline_layer24, then use Euclidean dot(d, v24[target]) as target-coordinate score and absolute dot products against the other two independently unit-normalized class vectors as off-axis scores.

new_promotion_blockers.observation: The queued executor bypasses the existing calibration-only semantic-simplex rank analyzer and does not require agreement on whether the native three-state geometry is 1D or 2D before intervention and downstream interpretation.
new_promotion_blockers.implication: A runtime PASS can establish a task-bounded class-selective native intervention effect, but cannot establish that the intervention is acting in the previously specified native J-Space coordinate system. Representation rank, intervention rank and downstream transport rank are not forced to agree.

new_promotion_blockers.observation: After nuisance projection, each of the three centered semantic vectors is normalized independently. The earlier rank-aware builder instead divides projected class centroids by one shared scale and preserves their zero-sum simplex geometry.
new_promotion_blockers.implication: Independent unit normalization preserves radial direction but not relative centroid radius or pairwise class distances. Therefore the queued cvecs are a reparameterized three-direction controller, not a faithful transport of the previously defined native class geometry.

new_promotion_blockers.observation: The three layer-24 class vectors are centered class directions and are not established as an orthonormal basis or dual basis. In a centered three-class simplex they are linearly dependent in at most two dimensions. Raw Euclidean dot products against all three therefore do not constitute independent semantic coordinates.
new_promotion_blockers.implication: matched_target_coordinate_mean should be interpreted as a target-alignment score under the frozen estimator, not as measured transport of a well-defined J-Space coordinate. Promotion requires coordinates in an admitted orthonormal 1D/2D basis (or an explicitly justified dual/causal metric).

new_promotion_blockers.observation: For a three-state geometry, -v[target] is only guaranteed to point away from the target radial direction. Unless rank-1 geometry is established and a semantic antipode is preregistered, the negative vector is not guaranteed to correspond to either of the other semantic states.
new_promotion_blockers.implication: A negative sign-flip effect is useful anti-target causal evidence. It is not by itself proof of a single bidirectional semantic axis. If rank 2 is required, causal tests should be expressed in the admitted 2D simplex/subspace coordinates and use target-to-target displacement predictions rather than semantic-opposite language.

counterhypotheses_retained.statement: The current intervention works as three task-specific class actuator directions even though no stable rank-aware semantic coordinate system exists.
The native three-state relation is genuinely rank 2; forcing interpretation through independently normalized target vectors and sign flips obscures rather than proves its geometry.
The reported downstream target dominance depends on the chosen Euclidean dot-product estimator and may not survive an admitted orthonormal/dual basis or cross-family geometry test.

external_research_inputs.source: The Geometry of Categorical and Hierarchical Concepts in Large Language Models
external_research_inputs.use: Primary literature explicitly generalizes linear-representation analysis from binary directions to categorical concepts represented geometrically as polytopes; supports not forcing a three-state concept into an unverified single signed axis. Context only, not Clay runtime evidence.

external_research_inputs.source: Beyond Single Concept Vector: Modeling Concept Subspace in LLMs with Gaussian Distribution
external_research_inputs.use: Reports instability of single concept vectors across data/training and motivates subspace/distributional robustness rather than treating one direction as canonical. Context only.

external_research_inputs.source: The Linear Representation Hypothesis and the Geometry of Large Language Models
external_research_inputs.use: Shows that geometric interpretation depends on the metric/inner product and connects causal counterfactual formulations to steering; supports treating raw Euclidean hidden-state dot products as an operational estimator unless separately justified. Context only.

external_research_inputs.source: Cross-Architecture Steering Transfer in Language Models: A Systematic Empirical Study
external_research_inputs.use: Provides recent empirical evidence that functional steering generalization degrades at very small model scales, reinforcing exact-model and cross-family revalidation for Qwen3-0.6B. Context only.

successor_gate_delta.phase_1_calibration_rank: On successor calibration families, run the existing deterministic simplex-rank analyzer after the chosen nuisance treatment. Require raw/family-balanced agreement: 1D, 2D, or fail closed.
successor_gate_delta.phase_2_geometry: Construct intervention vectors from the admitted rank-aware basis with one shared geometry scale and preserved zero-sum class centroid geometry. Freeze basis, gain rule and metric before successor holdout.
successor_gate_delta.phase_3_downstream: At layer-input 24, independently reconstruct/admit the downstream rank-aware basis. Measure intervened-minus-baseline displacement in orthonormal basis coordinates. Require representation rank, intervention rank and downstream transport rank to agree or explicitly explain a preregistered rank transition.
successor_gate_delta.phase_4_causality_rank1: If rank 1 is supported, preregister semantic ordering/poles and require +/− interventions to reverse the scalar coordinate and target behavior; require NEUTRAL placement to satisfy the frozen rank-1 geometry rule.
successor_gate_delta.phase_4_causality_rank2: If rank 2 is required, drop semantic-opposite wording for simple sign flip. Require target-specific displacement toward the frozen 2D target centroid, away-from-target behavior for negative radial controls, and pairwise target-to-target interventions whose observed coordinate displacement matches the preregistered simplex displacement direction.
successor_gate_delta.phase_5_generalization: Combine this rank-consistency gate with Run-2's already recorded cross-task-family, per-target positivity, strict controls, off-target regression, replication and v12 immutable binding requirements.
successor_gate_delta.promotion_scope_on_pass: QWEN3_0_6B_RANK_CONSISTENT_CROSS_TASK_NATIVE_CONTROL_COMPONENT_ONLY; Global J-Space/GWT still requires evidence of broader workspace/state coordination.
